consortium.description_generic: Consortia that use OpenRS DCB can include any combination of public, academic and specialist libraries and collections. <paragraph/>DCB connects libraries across ILS, LMS and Discovery products to handle resource sharing at scale, whether they choose to use the same or a mix of commercial or open source interfaces and central indexes.<paragraph/>

brand.section_help: What patrons see in the discovery app. This is separate from the images above, which are used in DCB Admin.
brand.logo_url_help: The lockup shown above the search box. Upload one, or paste a full web address beginning http:// or https://. Leave blank to show the consortium's name on its own.
brand.logo_url_invalid: Upload an image, or enter a full web address beginning http:// or https://, or leave this blank.
brand.logo_alt_help: Read aloud in place of the logo. Leave blank to use the consortium's display name.
brand.header_icon_url_help: A SQUARE mark for the app bar and the browser tab. Not a smaller logo — a lockup in a 32-pixel box is unreadable. Leave blank to show no icon.
brand.background_image_url_help: The image behind the search box on the landing page. Decorative, so it is never read aloud, and text over it sits on a tint so it stays readable. Leave blank to use the theme's own treatment.
brand.upload_formats: PNG or JPEG. SVG and WebP are not accepted.
brand.upload_too_large: That image is larger than 2 MB. Export it smaller and try again.
brand.upload_failed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again, or paste a web address instead.
brand.staged: {{filename}} will be uploaded when you save.
brand.image_url_staged: Remove the chosen file to enter a web address instead.
brand.external_url_cost: An address on someone else's server means every patron's browser fetches the image from them: if their site is down the branding disappears, and their logs record each patron's IP address. Uploading avoids both.
brand.theme_help: Chosen from the themes the discovery app ships. Every one has been checked for colour contrast in light, dark and high-contrast modes.
brand.patron_welcome_help: Shown to patrons under the search box. This is not the description above, which is for staff.

explainer.pickup_anywhere: When enabled, patrons can collect a request at any eligible pickup location in the consortium, not only at their own library. Note that individual pickup locations must also be enabled for pickup anywhere separately.
explainer.re_resolution: When enabled, re-resolution will be active for this consortium. This means that if the chosen supplier cannot fulfil a request, OpenRS DCB automatically looks for another supplier instead of failing the request.
explainer.own_library_borrowing: When enabled, items held by the patron's own library are included when OpenRS DCB resolves a request.
explainer.trigger_supplier_renewal: When enabled, if a loan is renewed at the borrowing library, OpenRS DCB mirrors that renewal at the supplying library.
explainer.virtual_patron_names_visible: When enabled, virtual patron records will carry the real patron's name. Leave off to keep virtual patrons anonymous.
explainer.deny_library_mapping_edit: When enabled, this prevents library staff from editing their mappings in DCB Admin for Libraries. Leave disabled if you want to manage mappings centrally.
explainer.select_unavailable: Items that are currently on loan or otherwise unavailable are still offered when DCB resolves a request, rather than skipped.

config_fields.mode_label: How to enter the client configuration
config_fields.json_mode_warning: Advanced mode. Everything the guided form asks for still has to be present, and switching back will drop any keys the guided form does not know about.
config_fields.unmapped_keys: These keys were in the JSON and have no guided field, so they will not be saved: {{keys}}
config_fields.recommended_missing_body: The Host LMS will be created without these, but requests are likely to fail later: {{fields}}
config_fields.ingest_description: Whether DCB harvests bibliographic records from this system.
config_fields.default_agency_code_description: The agency to attribute a patron to when their home location has no mapping. Leave blank on a shared system: with several libraries here, no single agency can stand in.
config_fields.ors_default_agency_code_description: The agency DCB names for this appliance in NCIP messages. Required whether or not the appliance serves several libraries.
config_fields.shared_system_description: Set this when more than one participating library is hosted on this system. DCB then requires every branch to be mapped to an agency explicitly, instead of falling back to a default agency or a wildcard, either of which would silently attribute one library's patrons or holdings to another.
config_fields.shared_system_conflict: A shared system cannot have a default agency code. With several libraries on one system, no single agency can stand in for an unmapped location - map each library's locations to its agency instead.
config_fields.page_size_description: How many records DCB requests per harvest page. 100 is a reasonable starting point.
config_fields.alma_url_description: The regional Ex Libris API gateway your Alma instance is served from, e.g. https://api-na.hosted.exlibrisgroup.com. Your region is listed under “Calling Alma APIs”.
config_fields.alma_base_url_description: Your institution's own Alma domain, with no path, e.g. https://example.alma.exlibrisgroup.com. This is the host DCB harvests records from, not the API gateway.
config_fields.alma_apikey_description: An Alma API key with read and write permissions for Users, Requests, Bibs, Holdings, Items and Configuration.
config_fields.alma_api_docs_link: See the Ex Libris Alma API documentation.
config_fields.alma_item_docs_link: See the Ex Libris item schema documentation.
config_fields.alma_connection_group_description: If your Alma system restricts access by IP address, the OpenRS DCB server's IP must be whitelisted before these details will work. Ask your OpenRS team or hosting provider for the address.
config_fields.alma_resource_sharing_group_description: The Alma library and locations DCB moves items through. These must exist in Alma first: a resource sharing library (code RES_SHARE by default) holding the locations IN_RS_REQ for lending requests and OUT_RS_REQ for borrowing requests, both set to OPEN.
config_fields.alma_harvesting_group_description: DCB harvests bib records from Alma over OAI-PMH, which the Alma lending workflow depends on. If only your OAI services are IP restricted, the DCB server's IP still has to be whitelisted for them.
config_fields.alma_institution_code_description: Your Alma OAI-PMH institution code, e.g. 01ABC_DEF. DCB builds the harvest address from it, so a wrong value stops ingest rather than the API.
config_fields.alma_sharing_library_code_description: The code of the Alma library used for lending through OpenRS. DCB uses RES_SHARE by default. Alma needs a library that represents everywhere outside the system, otherwise a check-in sends the item to the hold shelf instead of into transit.
config_fields.alma_virtual_item_library_code_descripti: The code of the Alma library DCB creates virtual items at. Alma cannot report a patron's home location reliably, so this has to be agreed with your Alma staff.
config_fields.alma_virtual_item_location_code_descript: The code of the location within that library where virtual items are created, e.g. OUT_RS_REQ.
config_fields.alma_default_circ_desk_code_description: The code of the circulation desk OpenRS DCB checks items out at.
config_fields.alma_pickup_circ_desk_description: The circulation desk used when a patron collects an item, if it differs from the default.
config_fields.alma_item_policy_description: The Alma item policy applied to the virtual items DCB creates. Codes come from the ItemPolicy code table.
config_fields.alma_shelf_location_description: The shelf location recorded on virtual items DCB creates.
config_fields.alma_user_identifier_description: The Alma user identifier DCB matches patrons on. Leave blank to match on the primary identifier.
config_fields.alma_oai_set_description: The OAI set you are making available to OpenRS DCB. Leave blank to harvest everything your institution publishes.
config_fields.alma_metadata_prefix_description: The OAI-PMH metadata prefix DCB harvests with. Alma publishes marc21. Harvesting cannot start without this.
config_fields.sierra_base_url_description: The root URL of the Sierra system, without the API path.
config_fields.sierra_key_description: The client key for the Sierra API account.
config_fields.sierra_secret_description: The client secret paired with the API key.
config_fields.patron_search_tag_description: The Sierra varfield tag DCB searches patrons by.
config_fields.virtual_patron_pin_description: PIN applied to the virtual patron records DCB creates.
config_fields.get_holds_retry_attempts_description: How many times to retry reading a patron's holds before giving up.
config_fields.place_hold_delay_description: Seconds to wait before placing a hold, for systems that need settling time.
config_fields.get_hold_delay_description: Seconds to wait before reading a hold back after placing it.
config_fields.virtual_item_library_code_description: The library virtual items are created at.
config_fields.virtual_item_location_code_description: The location virtual items are created at.
config_fields.folio_base_url_description: The base URL for this FOLIO tenant.
config_fields.folio_apikey_description: An edge API key for the FOLIO tenant, issued by your FOLIO administrator.
config_fields.folio_tenant_description: The tenant identifier. DCB warns when this is missing.
config_fields.user_base_url_description: Base URL for FOLIO's user endpoints, where these differ from the main gateway.
config_fields.record_syntax_description: OAI-PMH record syntax used for harvesting, e.g. marcxml.
config_fields.metadata_prefix_description: OAI-PMH metadata prefix used for harvesting.
config_fields.polaris_base_url_description: The root URL of the Polaris system.
config_fields.base_url_application_services_descriptio: Base URL of the Polaris Application Services API.
config_fields.domain_id_description: The Polaris domain the staff account belongs to.
config_fields.logon_branch_id_description: Branch the DCB staff account signs in against.
config_fields.logon_user_id_description: Polaris user ID of the DCB staff account.
config_fields.staff_username_description: Username of the DCB staff account.
config_fields.staff_password_description: Password of the DCB staff account.
config_fields.papi_description: Polaris PAPI connection details. DCB requires this section to be present.
config_fields.services_description: Polaris application services details. DCB requires this section to be present.
config_fields.services_organisation_id_description: Organisation identifier used by application services.
config_fields.services_site_domain_description: Site domain the staff account authenticates against.
config_fields.services_patron_barcode_prefix_descripti: Prefix applied to virtual patron barcodes.
config_fields.item_description: Defaults applied to the virtual items DCB creates. DCB requires this section to be present.
config_fields.barcode_prefix_description: Prefix applied to virtual item barcodes.
config_fields.ill_location_id_description: Location identifier used for interlibrary loan items.
config_fields.fine_code_id_description: Fine code applied to virtual items.
config_fields.renewal_limit_description: Renewal limit applied to virtual items.
config_fields.renewal_limit_av_description: Renewal limit applied to audiovisual virtual items, where it differs from the standard one.
config_fields.history_action_id_description: History action identifier recorded against virtual items.
config_fields.shelving_scheme_id_description: Shelving scheme identifier for virtual items.
config_fields.loan_period_code_id_description: Loan period code applied to virtual items.
config_fields.koha_api_url_description: The root of the Koha REST API, e.g. https://koha.example.org/api/v1. Note this is 'api-url', not the 'base-url' other systems use.
config_fields.koha_client_id_description: Client ID of the Koha API account DCB authenticates as.
config_fields.koha_client_secret_description: Client secret paired with the OAuth client ID.
config_fields.koha_sharing_library_code_description: The Koha library used to ship resources outside this system.
config_fields.koha_connection_group_description: The Koha REST API account DCB circulates through, and the libraries it creates virtual items at.
config_fields.koha_harvesting_group_description: DCB harvests bib records from Koha's OPAC over OAI-PMH. In Koha, set the OAI-PMH system preference to Enable and give OAI-PMH:archiveID a value. Leave the OAI set blank to harvest the whole catalogue.
config_fields.koha_base_url_description: The root of the Koha OPAC, with no path, e.g. https://catalogue.example.org. This is not the API URL above: Koha serves OAI-PMH from the OPAC at /cgi-bin/koha/oai.pl, while the REST API is often reached through the staff interface.
config_fields.koha_metadata_prefix_description: The OAI-PMH metadata prefix DCB harvests with. Use marcxml on a stock Koha. Check ?verb=ListMetadataFormats on the OPAC before using anything else, as marc21 exists only where an OAI-PMH:ConfFile defines it. Harvesting cannot start without this.
config_fields.koha_oai_set_description: The OAI set to restrict harvesting to. Leave blank to harvest every record, which is what most members want. A set only works once Koha has built it, through OAI-PMH:AutoUpdateSets or build_oai_sets.pl.
config_fields.koha_oai_path_description: Overrides the path appended to the OPAC URL. Only needed where the site rewrites Koha's default /cgi-bin/koha/oai.pl.
config_fields.base_protocol_description: Which protocol this system speaks: NCIP or SIP2. NCIP is used when this is left blank.
config_fields.foundation_ncip_endpoint_url_description: The NCIP v2.02 responder URL. Required when the base protocol is NCIP.
config_fields.sip2_group_description: Only needed when the base protocol is SIP2. The SIP2 transport is not yet implemented, so these operations will fail until it is.
config_fields.sip2_host_description: Hostname or IP of the SIP2 server.
config_fields.sip2_port_description: TCP port of the SIP2 server. Usually 6001.
config_fields.sip2_login_description: Username DCB signs in to the SIP2 server with.
config_fields.sip2_pass_description: Password paired with the SIP2 login.
config_fields.sip2_location_code_description: Location DCB identifies as. Defaults to SC (self check).
config_fields.ors_base_url_description: The root URL of the appliance, without a path.
config_fields.ors_ncip_endpoint_url_description: The appliance's NCIP v2.02 endpoint. DCB places and manages requests through it.
config_fields.ncip_system_id_description: The SystemId this appliance is known by in NCIP messages.
config_fields.ncip_agency_id_description: The AgencyId directory symbol for this system. The NCIP system ID is used when this is blank.
config_fields.oai_endpoint_url_description: Where DCB harvests bib records from. Either this or the tenant ID is needed for ingest to run at all.
config_fields.tenant_id_description: Used to derive the OAI-PMH path when no endpoint URL is given.
config_fields.ncip_peer_auth_group_description: How DCB verifies NCIP messages arriving from this appliance. Without these, inbound messages are not authenticated.
config_fields.ncip_peer_auth_mode_description: JWT_REQUIRED to demand a signed token on inbound NCIP, or INSECURE to accept unauthenticated messages.
config_fields.ncip_peer_issuer_description: The only JWT issuer accepted from this peer.
config_fields.ncip_peer_jwks_url_description: Where the peer's signing keys are published.
config_fields.ncip_peer_audience_description: The audience claim inbound tokens from this peer must carry.
config_fields.must_be_object: This must be a JSON object of key and value pairs.
config_fields.roles_description: Which DCB roles this system fulfils, e.g. CATALOGUE, CIRCULATION. Leave blank for the defaults.
config_fields.staff_ui_description: Where staff sign in to this system. Used for links out of DCB Admin.
config_fields.context_hierarchy_description: Mapping contexts searched in order, most specific first, e.g. this system's code then its consortium then GLOBAL.
config_fields.shelf_location_policy_map_description: Maps each Polaris shelf location to a lending policy (REFERENCE, NO_LEND, LOCAL_ONLY). DCB uses defaults when this is left blank.
config_fields.use_new_bib_chunk_ingest_description: Harvest bib records using the newer chunked method.
config_fields.av_loan_period_code_id_description: Loan period applied to audiovisual virtual items, where it differs from the standard one.

openrs.name: OpenRS

dcb.description: $t(app.dcb) is an $t(openrs.name) product that enables libraries to deliver direct consortial borrowing services to their patrons across a range of LMS and discovery systems. <paragraph/> Developed by <linkComponent>$t(openrs.who.kint_full)</linkComponent>, $t(app.dcb) helps consortia fulfil patrons borrowing requests across their membership faster and cheaper than traditional resource sharing methods.<paragraph/>

openrs.description: $t(openrs.name)  is a resource sharing initiative of the <linkComponent>$t(openrs.who.olf_full)</linkComponent>. <paragraph/>The open source project is reinventing resource sharing to meet the needs of different types of consortia, using open standards and native integration to provide consortia with robust and extended functionality for consortial resource sharing.<paragraph/>
